APPL.name: Application
APPL.definition: Key used to protect application information.

DATA.name: Data
DATA.definition: Key used to protect data in the messages.

DYNC.name: Dynamic
DYNC.definition: Any cryptographic key that can be downloaded.

KENC.name: Key Encryption
KENC.definition: Key used to encrypt other keys.

MACK.name: MAC
MACK.definition: Key used to generate the MAC of a message.

PINK.name: PIN
PINK.definition: Key used to encrypt a PIN.

WRKG.name: Working
WRKG.definition: Temporary key used to download keys.
